name: Miura (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Miura city emblem in red: three interlocking loops in a row, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Miura, a city in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 January 1956.

features.role: Miura city emblem — three interlocking loops in a row, like a stylised character
